sv.title: Rasmus Giertz framtid osäker: ”I frysboxen”
sv.summary: Rasmus Giertz skulle lämna riksdagen – men ändrade sig. Nu utreder SD om han ska uteslutas. Under tiden sitter han kvar på partiets mandat. ”Kort sagt befinner han sig i frysboxen”, skriver SD:s presschef Oskar Cavalli-Björkman.

en.title: Rasmus Giertz's future uncertain: "In the freezer"
en.summary: Rasmus Giertz was to leave the Riksdag – but changed his mind. Now the Sweden Democrats are investigating whether he should be expelled. In the meantime he remains in the party's seat. "In short, he is in the freezer", writes SD press chief Oskar Cavalli-Björkman.
